label: Biological Omega threats and laboratory control surfaces
public_interest_question: How do high-consequence biological capability, material, information, laboratories, synthesis, automation, funding, publication, oversight, public-health response, and remedy move through bounded surfaces, and where do effective control and answerable power exist or fail without converting scientific proximity into suspicion?
selection_unit: one source-addressable protocol, review, grant, material custody event, synthesis or provider decision, model-access object, publication decision, inspection, international report, incident, exercise, remedy, or bounded case contract admitted under a declared rule
selection_universe: the union of independently declared case universes covering natural emergence, accidental release, deliberate misuse, material custody, synthesis, AI and automation, institutional oversight, information release, national and international governance, detection, response capacity, recurrence, and remedy
inclusion_rules: include only objects admitted under a frozen source-complete, rule-based, or matched-comparator universe before result interpretation
include positive, negative, ordinary, failed, unavailable, disputed, corrected, and contradictory outcomes under the same predicates
require a source-addressable public-role, institutional, scientific, regulatory, commercial, legal, incident, or response predicate before any object may leave intake
preserve distinctions among research question, receipt, claim, bounded surface, capability custody, control authority, incident, and actor hop
exclusion_rules: exclude pathogen-design instructions, sequence data, enhancement targets, laboratory exploit details, facility vulnerabilities, and operational targeting information
exclude patient-level health data, private contact details, home addresses, protected-trait aggregation, and unnecessary worker identity
exclude actors or institutions selected only because they are famous, politically contested, geographically convenient, or expected to support a preferred origin theory
exclude broad laboratories, universities, agencies, journals, funders, countries, or scientific fields as automatic actor adjacency or risk evidence
exclude machine-proposed cases from canonical claims, scores, hops, chains, or publication narration

comparison.comparator_class: ordinary laboratories and research programmes, comparable providers and institutions, positive and negative incident records, analogous jurisdictions, and source-complete policy or market denominators defined by each case
comparison.symmetry_rule: Apply the same predicates, source routes, temporal tests, identity rules, security review, privacy controls, and evidentiary burdens regardless of country, institution, suspected origin, political alignment, funding source, research topic, or expected public reaction.

preferred_evidence_order: primary public institutional or provider material
source_strategy.null_policy: A null is bounded to the declared source, identity bundle, date window, query, access state, and security constraints. Source failure, confidentiality, incomplete reporting, unresolved identity, or nonpublication cannot be narrated as factual absence.
source_strategy.security_policy: Public outputs carry only safe abstractions. Restricted evidence may support an authorized review but cannot be copied into the public graph or publication surface.
source_strategy.cross_case_policy: Cross-case recurrence and topology are structural context only and never create a Clifford hop or origin attribution by themselves.

replicability.reason: The selection and programme contracts are reproducible research instructions, not observed evidence or completed coverage.

review.sunset_condition: Suspend target-specific acquisition if the programme cannot preserve neutral denominators, ordinary and negative controls, safe publication boundaries, symmetric treatment of competing origin hypotheses, or independent biosafety and privacy review.

consumption.what_this_is: A staged cross-domain research declaration joining biological Omega control questions to bounded-surface topology and answerable-power testing.
consumption.what_this_is_not: A finding of outbreak origin, laboratory fault, unsafe research, coordination, malicious intent, legal noncompliance, scientific invalidity, complete coverage, or absence outside a declared source search.
consumption.copy_ready_caveat: This programme records bounded research instructions and control questions, not verified findings. A laboratory, grant, publication, provider relationship, committee role, policy, capability statement, missing record, incident report, or shared surface does not establish origin, misuse, intent, coordination, influence, causation, negligence, illegality, wrongdoing, or absence. Follow every eventual claim to its source, evidence class, time window, security treatment, selection rule, and independent review status.
